state: Mutation accepted; intended state not observed
why: HAC-217 rules this a mandatory terminal state: acceptance is not success, and the distinction is central to the trust surface. HAC-226 binds it into Receipts.
transformation: writeback.observation.polls: 1 -> 12, elapsedMs raised to the full timeoutMs
writeback.after.evidenceTier: set to the before-state value, so the after-state reads cleanly and shows the pre-mutation answer
note: The after-state read still succeeds. That is the point: `read: ok` and a stale answer are two facts, and a surface collapsing them would lose the distinction exactly where it matters. Every mutation attempt is left untouched and still succeeded, so the mutation is genuinely accepted and genuinely unconfirmed.
